name: smwsprites-numbered-multi-hit-p-switch
title: Numbered Multi-Hit P-Switch
description:
A modification of the P-Switch which allows it to be used multiple times and show a number for how many uses are remaining.


Supports 1-9 uses or infinite and number of uses can be set in LM via the extension/extra bytes not requiring multiple inserts.

1.1 Update:
Is now inedible while in pressed state
Number takes the layer priority of the switch so it goes behind pipes when taking it through
0 in the number of uses also counts as infinite instead of showing 0 and underflowing
